corrections.now: For any NONTRIVIAL backward lambda-DSS blow-up profile of 3D Navier-Stokes the far-field decay exponent is pinned to EXACTLY alpha = 1. AT LEAST 1 by Chae-Wolf Thm 1.1 (an upper bound on |u| of the form C/(sqrt(-t)+|x|)). AT MOST 1 by Chae-Wolf Remark 1.2 -- which for the ACTUAL OBJECT (DSS at fixed lambda >> 1) is the ONLY primary statement of the implication -- terminating at Escauriaza-Seregin-Sverak, whose Navier-Stokes criterion is UNREACHABLE at primary here and is banked UNREACHABLE, never as a zero. Pineau-Vicol (2026) SS1.2 state the implication for ROTATED GLOBALLY self-similar solutions, NOT for DSS; they are INDEPENDENT AUTHORS, NOT AN INDEPENDENT PROOF, since their route also terminates at Escauriaza-Seregin-Sverak.
